description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kumbuka, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530176
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their ownership details, extent, and legal status. The content focuses on land ownership determinations, property registrations, and cadastral mapping - all core land and property-related matters that fall under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
